# Error #56: InvalidOracleThreshold

## Summary
- **Numeric Code**: `#56`
- **Variant Name**: `InvalidOracleThreshold`
- **Status**: Active (Enforced)
- **Client Toast Level**: `ERROR`
- **Retryable**: `Yes`

## Trigger Conditions
The contract rejects the call when any of these registry conditions holds:
- `Branch::InvalidOracleThreshold` — oracle threshold is invalid (e.g. zero or exceeds publisher count).

---

pubs.push_back(pub1);

## User Remediation Guidance
> **Plain-Language Remediation**:  
> Set `threshold` to at least 1 and no greater than the number of configured oracle publishers, then re-run `set_oracle_config`.
>
> **Reference**: [`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md#16-oracle-reference-clock--staleness-bounds`](../../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md#16-oracle-reference-clock--staleness-bounds)
